Review coverage & original source details

What was reviewed

All 53 identifiers from the supplied workbook and certificate collection are included, alongside three additional dashboard IDs. Each of the 56 complete IDs was matched in the NHPR account reviewed on 19 September 2026. Identifiers are not a count of distinct operating centres.

All four pages of one authenticated NHPR facility-manager account were reviewed. This is a dated account observation, not a live feed or a review of every account held by Pinnacle.

Original dashboard labels: 33 Approved · 14 Query Raised · 4 Submitted · 4 Rejected · 1 Query Resolved · 1 Draft. These are administrative workflow labels. They do not rate clinical quality, establish current operations or replace other premises-specific licences.

All 56 complete identifiers were matched to the authenticated NHPR / ABDM facility-manager dashboard on 19 September 2026. Statuses are the exact workflow labels displayed on that date, not a live feed or a clinical-quality rating. Approved, Submitted, Query Raised, Query Resolved and Rejected are kept distinct. One masked Draft is separate. Original workbook RS flags are preserved and do not define the registry status or whether a centre is operating. This check covers one authenticated NHPR account. Pinnacle advises that registrations may be administered across different accounts; those accounts have not been reconciled in this review.

The original collection contains all 52 workbook entries and 28 distinct IDs with inspected certificate copies, reconciled to 53 identifiers. The dashboard adds Bhimavaram IN2810051839, Nizamabad IN3610023029 and Khammam IN3610023023. The 37 ACTIVE and 15 INACTIVE workbook RS values are preserved; their operational meaning was not supplied.

Similar names, separate records: Tirupati, Bhimavaram, Khammam and Nizamabad each have two IDs in the reviewed dashboard. They are kept separately, without assuming replacement, cancellation or an additional physical centre. Karkhana is the dashboard label for the workbook’s Vikrampuri identifier IN3610023703. Karimnagar’s dashboard name field displays an address. Matching is by exact HFR identifier.

Addresses and postcode columns remain documentary source values. Confirm the premises with Pinnacle when choosing a centre.
